ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure shows the North Atlantic and the region west of Europe; island P is located in the Atlantic Ocean; Jia is marked in the Atlantic sea area, near the sea surface west of Europe, and the isotherms near Jia have an obvious bend. The shading of plateau and mountainous areas in the figure is mainly distributed in the land area near Yi, not at Jia. Then reason: the question asks for the main factor causing the isotherm at Jia to bend noticeably. Jia is located on the ocean, and abnormal bending of isotherms on the ocean surface is usually mainly affected by ocean currents; combined with the fact that this region also corresponds to the area affected by the North Atlantic Warm Current, therefore the main factor causing the isotherm at Jia to bend is ocean currents.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中甲标在大西洋海域，靠近P岛和欧洲西侧海面，附近等温线明显弯曲；高原山地阴影主要在乙附近陆地上，不在甲处。再推理：题目问甲处等温线弯曲的主要因素，甲位于海洋，海洋上造成等温线异常弯曲的典型因素是洋流，因此答案为洋流。
